text:
eric: Deploybot reported post-deploy smoke failures on the embed route in eu-west-1. Not universal but >20% of synth probes failing since the rollout finished.
maria: saw that. queueing the logs now. any obvious error class? tokenization, timeout, 5xx?
deploy-bot: deploy completed: service=embed-worker, version=2026.03.17-quantized, region=eu-west-1, canary=10% -> 50% -> 100% (completed). smoke-check: 14/72 failed (19%).
sre-oncall: grabbing traces and top stacktrace. initial glance shows tokenizer mismatch in the first tokenization step for long inputs.
julie: hmm—this release included a tokenizer hotfix + quantization change. maybe the tokenization model build used different vocab bump. any diffs between assets?
eric: snapshot of tokenizer metadata from prod vs new: ```
prod: vocab_id=20260310-v1
release: vocab_id=20260317-v2
``` 
maria: that explains it. some synthetic prompts rely on exact prefix splits, so mismatch causes longer sequences and p95 tokenization latency spikes.
sre-oncall: p95 latency on synth probes jumped from 120ms -> 540ms for embed route, and 5xx rate for short inputs increased slightly. attaching short log: ```
[2026-03-17T14:02:11Z] embed-worker: tokenization mismatch: expected 3 tokens got 5 for prompt id=abc123
[2026-03-17T14:02:11Z] embed-worker: request_time_ms=562
[2026-03-17T14:02:11Z] telemetry: synth_probe_fail
```
julie: recommendation: immediate hold and partial rollback to version=2026.03.10-quantized (vocab v1) for eu-west-1 only while we triage. we can pin routing to the older variant for eu-west-1 via routing policy.
eric: agree. do we want a full rollback or regional pin? traffic is healthy elsewhere, so regional pin preferred.
maria: I'll open the routing pin PR and start the rollback playbook for eu-west-1. quick command: `rtd route set embed-worker --region eu-west-1 --version 2026.03.10-quantized` — will validate.
sre-oncall: after pinning, run smoke again for 30m and watch synth pass rate + p95. also escalate to build infra to audit tokenizer artifact generation.
deploy-bot: action taken: routing pin applied for embed-worker region=eu-west-1 -> version=2026.03.10-quantized. traffic shift completed in 40s. smoke-check: 1/72 failed (1.4%).
eric: nice. can we also add a quick guardrail to pre-deploy: compare tokenizer vocab checksum with the model artifact checksum and fail deploy if vocab_id differs from expected manifest.
julie: will file a tiny change to the release pipeline. note for release notes: include "tokenizer artifact checksum validation" and add a canary step that runs synthetic prefix tests.
maria: filing changelog + incident note. follow-up tasks: 1) artifact audit, 2) add guardrail, 3) postmortem if root cause is mismatch in artifact bundling. tagging infra and build.
sre-oncall: keeping the thread open for 1h to ensure synth remains stable. ping me if anything else.
eric: thanks everyone :thumbsup:
